_description: MITRE ATLAS (Adversarial Threat Landscape for AI Systems) technique mappings for Phantex detection rules, ML models, and content classifiers.

AML.T0051.name: LLM Prompt Injection
AML.T0051.description: Adversary crafts malicious input to manipulate an LLM's behavior, bypassing alignment or safety constraints.

AML.T0051.001.name: Direct Prompt Injection
AML.T0051.001.description: Directly injecting malicious instructions into an LLM prompt.

AML.T0051.002.name: Indirect Prompt Injection
AML.T0051.002.description: Embedding malicious instructions in external data sources consumed by an LLM.

AML.T0020.name: Poison Training Data
AML.T0020.description: Adversary contaminates training data to embed backdoors or degrade model performance.

AML.T0015.name: Evade ML Model
AML.T0015.description: Adversary crafts inputs to evade detection by ML models while maintaining malicious functionality.

AML.T0024.name: Exfiltration via ML Inference API
AML.T0024.description: Using AI system APIs to exfiltrate sensitive data embedded in model responses.

AML.T0025.name: Exfiltration via Cyber Means
AML.T0025.description: Data extraction through conventional network channels triggered by AI agent operations.

AML.T0010.name: ML Supply Chain Compromise
AML.T0010.description: Compromising ML supply chain components (models, packages, MCP servers).

AML.T0029.name: Denial of ML Service
AML.T0029.description: Rendering AI agent services unavailable through resource exhaustion or overload.

AML.T0044.name: Full ML Model Access
AML.T0044.description: Adversary gains elevated access to the ML model, enabling attacks like extraction or manipulation.

AML.T0040.name: ML Model Inference API Access
AML.T0040.description: Leveraging inference API access for lateral movement through connected AI agent networks.

AML.T0043.name: Craft Adversarial Data
AML.T0043.description: Creating specifically crafted data to trigger misclassification or evasion.

AML.T0047.name: ML-Enabled Product Abuse
AML.T0047.description: Abusing AI-enabled product features for unintended malicious purposes.

AML.T0048.name: Command and Control via AI Agent
AML.T0048.description: Using compromised AI agents as C2 channels for issuing commands or relaying data.

high_tool_call_rate.rationale: Resource exhaustion / denial of AI service via excessive tool calls

suspicious_network_dest.rationale: Outbound connections to non-private IPs may indicate data exfiltration

excessive_file_read.rationale: Bulk file reads suggest data harvesting for exfiltration

credential_in_output.rationale: Credentials in AI output indicate direct data extraction

unknown_mcp_server.rationale: Unknown MCP server with code execution capabilities — supply chain risk

unusual_process_spawn.rationale: Process spawn from AI agent suggests privilege escalation or lateral movement

large_outbound_transfer.rationale: High-volume outbound transfer indicates active data exfiltration

new_network_connection.rationale: New/suspicious DNS lookup may indicate C2 communication attempt

sensitive_file_access.rationale: Access to credential/key files indicates data extraction attempt

trust_score_critical_drop.rationale: Sustained trust degradation suggests ongoing adversarial activity or evasion

trust_score_low_warning.rationale: Early warning for potential adversarial data crafting

adaptive_trust_threshold.rationale: Combined ML anomaly + trust degradation — possible model evasion

trust_permission_escalation.rationale: Low-trust agent requesting elevated permissions — privilege escalation

a2a_deep_delegation_chain.rationale: Deep A2A delegation chain can launder intent or evade attribution

a2a_circular_delegation.rationale: Circular delegation loop may indicate C2 relaying or denial of service

a2a_unverified_agent_delegation.rationale: Delegation to unverified agent — possible supply chain or impersonation

a2a_revoked_agent_contact.rationale: Communication with revoked agent — possible compromised identity

a2a_protocol_non_conformance.rationale: Protocol non-conformance may indicate evasion or crafted adversarial data

recording_downgrade_during_investigation.rationale: Recording downgrade during investigation — audit evasion

audit_chain_integrity_failure.rationale: Tamper-proof chain integrity failure — data integrity compromise

legal_hold_bypass_attempt.rationale: Legal hold bypass — product abuse / unauthorized access

mass_recording_disable.rationale: Bulk recording disable — audit evasion or denial of monitoring

cross_tenant_replay_attempt.rationale: Cross-tenant replay — lateral movement / unauthorized access

export_without_verification.rationale: Compliance export without chain verification — data integrity gap

mass_ioc_injection.rationale: Mass IoC injection — data poisoning / adversarial data crafting

unauthorized_feed_modification.rationale: Unauthorized feed modification — product abuse / unauthorized access

export_to_unknown_destination.rationale: IoC export to unknown destination — data exfiltration risk

high_severity_correlation_burst.rationale: Multiple critical IoC matches — active attack via AI agent C2

stix_import_large_bundle.rationale: Large STIX import — potential data poisoning or resource exhaustion

cross_tenant_ioc_leak.rationale: Cross-tenant IoC access — data exfiltration / lateral movement

isolation_forest_anomaly.rationale: IF detects statistical anomalies that may be evasion or adversarial data

xgboost_attack_class.rationale: XGB multi-class classifier directly maps to attack types → ATLAS techniques

autoencoder_anomaly.rationale: AE reconstruction error indicates novel/unseen pattern — possible evasion

prompt_injection_regex.rationale: 41 regex patterns detecting direct and indirect prompt injection

data_exfiltration_detector.rationale: Encoding/exfiltration pattern detection in AI outputs

secret_detector.rationale: 31 secret patterns — credentials in AI output

embedding_similarity.rationale: Cosine similarity to known attack corpus
